sections.h2: India's used-oil exports swing wildly, while imports never pass $5 million

chart.title: Exports jump and crash from year to year; imports stay tiny
chart.sub: HS 27109900 (waste motor, hydraulic and lubricating oil), US$ million by fiscal year.
chart.source: DGCI&S 8-digit trade data, as analysed in this article.

sections.means: Used oil is overwhelmingly a domestic story, since trade shows no steady export channel.

sections.h2: India's EPR recycling target climbs from 5% to 50% of sales by FY2030-31

chart.title: The mandated recycling share rises tenfold in six years
chart.sub: Recycling target as a share of prior-year sales or imports, %.

sections.means: The rule sets a stepped target that producers meet by buying certificates from registered recyclers.
sections.todo: Check whether the target is met, and whether collection centres can report volumes against it.

sections.h2: The EU regenerates 61% of collected waste oil, with the rest burned for energy

chart.title: Most EU waste oil goes back to base oil, not into heat
chart.sub: Share of EU waste oil collected in 2018, %.
chart.source: European Commission JRC, 'The economics of waste oil recycling in the EU' (2025).

sections.means: The EU benchmark is the only institutional figure here, and it favours regeneration on emissions and cost.
sections.todo: Ask for a cost-benefit study like the JRC's before India sets targets beyond its current 50% goal.
